lines.speaker: Supreme Kai
lines.text: My true identity is the Supreme Kai, or Kaioshin, but you may just call me Shin.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Huh. Are you above or below the Grand Kai? He had a dumb beard.

lines.speaker: Kibito
lines.text: The Supreme Kai are the highest ranking of them all, actually.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Cool! What about you? Are you also Supreme?

lines.speaker: Kibito
lines.text: I do not speak to Mortys.

lines.speaker: Supreme Kai
lines.text: It means mortal, which is what he should be saying.
